wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is entirely blank - not one ruled line inked. Cover line 1 carries a hand-drawn closed-loop zero glyph in all three columns (LAST / THIS / CUMULATIVE), which under the zero-glyph ruling is 0. Rows sum 0.00 = cover line1 CUMULATIVE 0. Gen-1 Carr form prints NO schedule total (the sheet ends with the 'If additional space is needed...' note), so the cover line is the only anchor - schedule_total is null, not zero. First report of the cycle (LAST column also 0), so the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: One inked row on Form B (p3), 225, equals cover line 3 THIS REPORT (225) and CUMULATIVE (225). LAST REPORT column carries the zero glyph, so this is the first report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide. Gen-1 Carr form prints no schedule total; schedule_total null.

gates.page_subtotal: No printed schedule total exists on either Gen-1 Carr schedule (p2/p3 both end in the 'use blank paper' note). Gated against the cover only: p2 rows sum 0.00 = cover line1 cum 0; p3 rows sum 225 = cover line3 cum 225.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py not used as an oracle here (the Gen-1 sheet is ruled lines, not a boxed grid, and the tool mis-detects such sheets); counted ink by eye at 200 dpi: p2 has 0 inked lines of ~40 ruled, p3 has exactly 1 inked line of ~40 ruled -> 1 expenditure row emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 amount-cell crop pct:82.00,9.50,13.00,2.50 rendered at 600 dpi shows '225' and nothing else; the control box one row-pitch below (y+2.17) renders empty.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at end of period) is BLANK in all three columns - the filer left it empty - so no balance line to check. Arithmetic on the printed lines: 0 (contrib cum) - 225 (expense cum) = -225, which the filer did not record.

escalation_note: p3 row 1 re-rendered as a full-width 600 dpi strip (date/vendor/purpose/amount) and the amount cell alone at 600 dpi.
notes: Gen-1 Carr Printing 5-5-PG form (cover cites Utah Code 17-16-6.5). PDF has only 3 pages - the statute page 4 is absent from this scan (the form's own text says the law is printed on page four); recorded as a scan property, not a data gap. Cover 'Name of Office' reads 'County Commission Seat B' - agrees with the chunk file's 'Commission Seat B'. Full name on the form 'Slade Rudy Hughes' agrees. Signature date 4-6-2010; RECEIVED stamp APR 6 2010. Candidate's street address, city, ZIP fragment and home phone are printed in the clear on the cover and were discarded at read time. Cover lines 1 and 2 use a closed-loop hand zero in every column; per the zero-glyph ruling these are 0 and the glyph is recorded here.

expenditures.note: Date written 'Mar 17 20' with a superscript '10' after the 20 = Mar 17 2010. Amount written as bare '225' with no cents and no decimal point; transcribed verbatim. Form B on this Gen-1 sheet has no in-kind column.
